name: UNC13A
technical_accuracy_of_explore_claim: PARTIALLY_INACCURATE_CORRECTED: Primary cryptic-exon dPSI (+0.4632, FDR=2.31e-19), Ribo-seq (-0.7811, padj=0.0296), and read-length bias (Motor 125bp vs 100bp OR=3.8937, p=3.38e-4) verified; corrected two ExploreALS errors: (1) candidates.csv misquoted rs12608932 AlphaGenome AVI as 27.6 (live Atlas confirms Phred=0.0246 for rs12608932 and Phred=8.9021 for rs12973192 in TDP-43-replete reference), and (2) E2116 misattributed Bryce-Smith ST5 383/926 ALE specificity (which is STMN2) to UNC13A (actual NYGC specificity is 61/860 TDP+ vs 0/246 non-TDP/Ctrl in Ma 2022 MOESM6).
causal_vs_reactive_assessment: CAUSAL_GENETIC_AND_MECHANISTIC_DRIVER: Germline GWAS/sQTL risk alleles (rs12608932 intronic, rs12973192 inside the cryptic exon) directly weaken residual TDP-43 repression at the intron 20-21 cryptic exon, coupling nuclear TDP-43 depletion to NMD-mediated loss of presynaptic Munc13-1 vesicle priming.
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Germline GWAS risk + sQTL + 100% TDP-43-pathology cryptic exon specificity (Ma 2022 61/860 vs 0/246; Spillman 2026 6/10 C9FTD vs 0/10 Ctrl, p=0.0108) + GC/cell-composition-adjusted NYGC mRNA depletion across all 4 CNS regions (Motor -0.1976 p=0.0105, Frontal -0.1565 p=0.00187, Cervical -0.2912 p=0.00330, Lumbar -0.3554 p=7.38e-4; O'Neill 2025 ALS-Glia Cortical n=64 [5 ALS-Glia vs 59 Ctrl]: beta=-0.8266, p=8.62e-4) + gnomAD extreme LoF intolerance (pLI=1.000, LOEUF=0.344) prove UNC13A loss causally drives TDP-43 synaptopathy.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Does NOT disprove biological validity, but deprioritizes standalone me-too single-target ASO monotherapy (crowded by 4 recruiting Phase 1/2 trials on LY4256984 and TRCN-1023, neither yet with completed Phase 2/3 clinical efficacy proof) and shows single-CE rescue is incomplete across polygenic TDP-43 spliceopathy (Guo et al. 2026) while soluble CSF UNC13A protein is undetectable (DS045=0 peptides).
factual_justification: Unlike Riluzole or Methylcobalamin, UNC13A has not yet completed Phase 2/3 human clinical efficacy proof, possesses genome-wide human ALS causal GWAS/sQTL genetics directly inside its cryptic exon (rs12608932/rs12973192; EV-B1-001..EV-B1-005), and is indispensable for presynaptic vesicle release. Standalone me-too single-target ASOs (LY4256984, TRCN-1023) are clinically crowded and explicitly deprioritized; UNC13A is retained in KEEP_CORE specifically as a combinatorial multiplex splice-rescue anchor (KCNQ2 + UNC13A + STMN2, per Guo et al. 2026 showing single-CE rescue is incomplete).
discriminating_next_test: Head-to-head multiplexed splice-switching ASO / engineered U7-snRNA rescue of KCNQ2 + UNC13A + STMN2 vs single-target ASOs (UNC13A-only, STMN2-only, KCNQ2-only) in TDP-43-depleted human sALS iPSC-MNs quantifying intrinsic electrophysiological excitability, presynaptic vesicle priming/MEA network bursting, neurite outgrowth, and neuronal survival.

name: STMN2
technical_accuracy_of_explore_claim: VERIFIED_WITH_COMPARTMENT_NUANCE: Primary exon-2a dPSI (+0.4820, FDR=3.02e-18), Ribo-seq (-2.9241, padj=1.57e-173), Zeng intronic PAS dPAS (+0.4564, padj=0), Bryce-Smith NYGC specificity (383/926 vs 0/750), and DS045 CSF TMT non-significance (+0.0423, p=0.2188) verified exactly. Added compartment nuance: whole-gene cortical STMN2 mRNA is paradoxically elevated in NYGC Frontal (+0.3177, p=6.29e-6, n=104) and Pineda BA4 (n=32) / BA9 (n=33) Excitatory neurons (+0.4972 p=2.23e-4 / +0.7194 p=1.24e-4) despite 72.5% Lumbar sALS tSTMN2 cryptic gain and -0.4825 (p=0.0140) frontal brain protein loss.
causal_vs_reactive_assessment: DOWNSTREAM_CAUSAL_EFFECTOR_OF_AXONOPATHY: Lacks germline ALS GWAS loci, so not an upstream genetic initiator, but TDP-43-loss-driven exon-2a cryptic polyadenylation causes ~87% Ribo-seq loss and motor neuropathy in Stmn2-null mice (PMID:35294901) that synergizes with TDP-43 pathology (PMID:39603486).
evidence_proves_hypothesis: 10/10 TDP-43 KD cohorts, 100% specificity across 1,676 NYGC samples (383/926 TDP-path vs 0/750 non-path), 72.5% Lumbar sALS tSTMN2 isoform prevalence, Spillman 2026 10/10 C9FTD CE with -28% frontal homogenate protein (log2FC=-0.4825, p=0.0140), gnomAD LoF intolerance (pLI=0.9999, LOEUF=0.261), and steric ASO rescue (PMID:36927019) establish STMN2 as the essential TDP-43 axonal regeneration effector.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Falsifies bulk cell-free CSF canonical STMN2 protein as a cross-sectional diagnostic/PD biomarker (DS045 Set 1 TMT log2diff=+0.0423, p=0.2188; Set 2 DIA undetected; Emory elapsed-yr rho=-0.094, p=0.590) and deprioritizes standalone me-too ASO monotherapy (crowded by QRL-201 NCT05633459 and BIIB147 NCT07855211, with single-CE rescue incomplete per Guo et al. 2026).
factual_justification: Neither QRL-201 nor BIIB147 has completed Phase 2/3 human clinical efficacy proof yet, and STMN2 exon-2a steric splice/PAS restoration is mechanistically indispensable for human motor axon outgrowth and NMJ maintenance (EV-B1-006..EV-B1-010). Standalone me-too single-target ASOs (QRL-201, BIIB147) are clinically crowded and explicitly deprioritized; STMN2 is retained in KEEP_CORE specifically as a combinatorial multiplex splice-rescue anchor alongside KCNQ2 and UNC13A (Guo et al. 2026).
discriminating_next_test: Test multiplexed splice-switching ASO / engineered U7-snRNA rescue of KCNQ2 + UNC13A + STMN2 vs single-target ASOs (STMN2-only, UNC13A-only, KCNQ2-only) in TDP-43-depleted sALS iPSC-MNs across axotomy neurite regeneration, electrophysiological M-current/hyperexcitability, synaptic transmission, and survival, paired with CSF EV tSTMN2 RNA PD.

name: KCNQ2
technical_accuracy_of_explore_claim: VERIFIED_AND_EXTENDED: Confirmed Brown 2022 in-frame exon-5 skipping (chr20:63439708-63444659 dPSI=+0.2139, FDR=4.15e-24; Ma 2022 FDR=1.45e-5) with NMD-escaping flat whole-gene i3Neuron RNA/Ribo-seq (padj=0.2286/0.9828) and preserved Spillman synaptosome protein (+0.2465, p=0.5268), plus demonstrated replicated GC-adjusted mRNA reduction across Pineda BA4 (-0.3021, p=0.0357, n=32), Pineda BA9 (-0.4037, p=0.0279, n=33), Edinburgh BA46 (-0.3403, p=0.0109, n=22), NYGC Cervical (-0.4650, p=2.84e-4, n=87), Motor (-0.2977, p=0.0289, n=59), Frontal (-0.2084, p=0.0103, n=104), and ALS-Glia Cortical (-1.0088, p=2.54e-5, n=64), tracking upper/lower MN vulnerability rather than NMD.
causal_vs_reactive_assessment: SOMATIC_DOWNSTREAM_TDP43_MEDIATOR_OF_HYPEREXCITABILITY: KCNQ2 lacks an ALS germline GWAS locus (somatic TDP-43 downstream effector, unlike UNC13A), but TDP-43 loss induces 42-aa in-frame deletion (KCNQ2-DeltaE5) that escapes NMD and co-assembles as a dominant-negative pore-dead Kv7.2 subunit at the axon initial segment, suppressing M-current and driving intrinsic ALS motor neuron hyperexcitability (Joseph et al. 2025, Nat Neurosci, PMID:41174170).
prior_art_crowding_level: LOW_FOR_SPLICE_ASO_MODERATE_FOR_SMALL_MOLECULE_OPENERS: Zero clinical trials for KCNQ2 exon-5 splice-switching ASOs or snRNAs; clinical trials to date tested only small-molecule Kv7 pore openers (Ezogabine Phase 2 NCT02450552; QRL-101 Phase 1 NCT06714396), which cannot repair mis-spliced pore-dead KCNQ2-DeltaE5 subunits.
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Replicated TDP-43-dependent exon-5 skipping across independent human neuron datasets (FDR=4.15e-24), postmortem ALS/FTD validation and splice-ASO electrophysiological rescue (Joseph et al. 2025, Nat Neurosci, PMID:41174170), extreme human Kv7.2 constraint (gnomAD pLI=1.000, LOEUF=0.258, mis_z=5.61; AlphaGenome exon-5 splice boundaries Phred=33.70-54.77), non-essential mitotic profile (DepMap Chronos=+0.0409), and prior human Phase 2 proof (NCT02450552) that Kv7 augmentation lowers ALS motor neuron excitability.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: No evidence disproves the hypothesis; KCNQ2 lacks a germline ALS GWAS locus and is undetectable in cell-free CSF proteomics (DS045=0 peptides), meaning clinical target engagement must deploy transcranial/axonal threshold-tracking neurophysiology (validated in NCT02450552) plus CSF EV exon-5/skip RNA rather than soluble CSF KCNQ2 protein.
factual_justification: KCNQ2 exon-5 splice restoration (Joseph et al. 2025, Nat Neurosci, PMID:41174170) addresses a clinically validated human ALS physiological defect (intrinsic motor hyperexcitability) via an uncrowded splice-switching mechanism (EV-B1-011..EV-B1-015) that overcomes NMD-escaping dominant-negative KCNQ2-DeltaE5 pore-dead subunit resistance to small-molecule Kv7 openers, serving both as an uncrowded lead and as the excitability arm of multiplexed KCNQ2 + UNC13A + STMN2 rescue.
discriminating_next_test: Test lead KCNQ2 exon-5 inclusion ASOs (single and multiplexed with UNC13A + STMN2 per Guo et al. 2026) in TDP-43-depleted human sALS iPSC-MNs head-to-head against QRL-101/ezogabine on M-current amplitude, repetitive firing, neurite outgrowth, and survival, paired with axonal threshold-tracking PD.

name: Partial normalization of CHMP7-CHMP2B nuclear surveillance
technical_accuracy_of_explore_claim: SUBSTANTIAL_CORRECTIONS_REQUIRED: (1) Purged ExploreALS's cross-axis citation of GDI2|P50395 CSF WGCNA stats (purple #11/65, DIA p=0.5042), which belongs to C015 Rab trafficking while CHMP7/CHMP2B/VPS4B are 0-peptide undetected in DS045 CSF; (2) Showed unadjusted NYGC cortical CHMP7 mRNA elevation (Motor +0.1682 p=0.00916, Frontal +0.1279 p=0.00523; GC=46.82%) collapses to null after GC + glial-composition adjustment (+0.0302 p=0.5742, +0.0313 p=0.2936), with Pineda BA4 Excitatory also null (-0.1224, p=0.2262, n=32); (3) Unbundled C014-N1 (CHMP7 primary) from C014-N2 (CHMP2B secondary).
causal_vs_reactive_assessment: UPSTREAM_COMPARTMENTAL_CASCADE_FOR_CHMP7_UNBUNDLED_MODIFIER_FOR_CHMP2B: SUN1-facilitated nuclear influx of CHMP7 (PMID:34321318, PMID:37639327, PMID:39486415) initiates NPC injury in sALS/C9 iPSNs; Keeley et al. 2024 (PMID:39709457) further showed endogenous WT CHMP2B promotes nuclear CHMP7 retention and partial CHMP2B KD mitigates NPC/TDP-43 injury (with Spillman 2026 cortical CHMP2B +0.337 p=0.0233 & pellet +0.566 p=0.0213), balanced against ANXA11-CHMP2B membrane/NE repair (PMID:42349418).
prior_art_crowding_level: LOW_CLINICAL_CROWDING: Zero interventional clinical trials targeting CHMP7 or CHMP2B on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT=0).
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Human sALS/C9orf72 postmortem nuclei and iPSC-MNs exhibit nuclear CHMP7 retention preceding NUP injury and TDP-43 mis-splicing, acute CHMP7 ASO lowering reverses NPC/STMN2 defects (PMID:34321318, PMID:37639327), and endogenous WT CHMP2B modulates nuclear CHMP7 accumulation in sALS iPSC-MNs (Keeley et al. 2024, PMID:39709457) alongside postmortem cortical/pellet CHMP2B protein accumulation (Spillman 2026 p=0.0233/0.0213).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Does NOT falsify partial nuclear normalization (flat bulk/snRNA-seq mRNA in EV-B1-016/017 reflects subcellular localization rather than transcript abundance), BUT falsifies deep or unbundled pan-ESCRT knockdown: CHMP7 is human LoF-intolerant (gnomAD pLI=0.9996, LOEUF=0.430), CRISPR-essential across 1,258 DepMap lines (mean Chronos=-0.6565, 66.2% <-0.5), and required for cortical activity-regulated genes (PMID:41744617) and telomeres (PMID:41677621), while WT CHMP2B is required with ANXA11 for stress-induced membrane/NE repair (PMID:42349418) and autophagy.
factual_justification: Per the Epistemic Asymmetry Rule, flat postmortem bulk/snRNA-seq mRNA and cell-free CSF non-detection cannot measure nuclear-pore retention and do not falsify C014. C014 is retained as KEEP_EXPLORATORY_UNPROVEN with strict sub-node unbundling: C014-N1 (CHMP7) as primary partial-lowering/import-blockade sub-node and C014-N2 (CHMP2B) as KEEP_EXPLORATORY_UNPROVEN_UNBUNDLED_SECONDARY (incorporating Keeley et al. 2024 PMID:39709457 + Spillman 2026 protein elevation vs ANXA11-CHMP2B repair PMID:42349418 and ESCRT/autophagy essentiality; EV-B1-016..EV-B1-021).
discriminating_next_test: Unbundled head-to-head chronic (>=8-week) study in mature sALS/C9 iPSC-MNs and adult TDP-43 mice comparing titrated CHMP7-only partial KD (25-50%), partial CHMP2B-only KD, dual CHMP7+CHMP2B KD, and selective SUN1-CHMP7 nuclear-influx blockade under mechanical/laser nuclear-envelope rupture and autophagic-flux challenge, co-measuring NUP/STMN2 rescue against ANXA11-CHMP2B membrane repair, cortical IEGs (Fos/Arc/Bdnf), and survival.
